He previously attended and played [[college basketball]] for the [[Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball|Indiana Hoosiers]]. ==High school career== Williams played his first three seasons at [[Phoebus High School]] in [[Hampton, Virginia]] before transferring to [[Oak Hill Academy (Mouth of Wilson, Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]] for his senior season. As a senior in 2012–13, he averaged 16.2 points, 7.5 rebounds, 4.0 assists and 2.0 blocks during the regular season, compiling nine double-doubles. He was named Gatorade Player of the Year for the state of Virginia and led Oak Hill to a regular season record of 34–5 and an appearance in the National High School Invitational.{{cite web|url=http://iuhoosiers.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=6426|title=Indiana Hoosiers – Troy Williams – 2015–16|work=IUHoosiers.com|accessdate=July 24, 2016}} {{College athlete recruit start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2013}} {{College athlete recruit entry | recruit = Troy Williams | position = G | hometown = Hampton, VA | highschool = Oak Hill Academy | feet = 6 | inches = 6 | weight = 190 | commitdate = October 28, 2012 | rivals stars = 4 | 247 stars = 4 | scout stars = 4 | espn stars = 4 }} {{College athlete recruit end | year = 2013 | rivals ref title = Indiana Commit List for 2013 | scout ref title = 2013 Indiana Basketball Commits | espn ref title = Indiana Hoosiers | 247 ref title = Indiana 2013 Basketball Commits | rivals school = indiana | scout s = 75 | espn schoolid = 84 | scout overall = 67 | rivals overall = 47 | 247 overall = 35 | espn overall = 54 | accessdate = July 1, 2015 | bball = yes }} ==College career== As a freshman at [[Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball|Indiana]] in 2013–14, Williams started all 32 games, averaging 7.3 points and 4.4 rebounds while shooting 50.9 percent from the floor. On March 10, 2014, he was named [[Big Ten Conference|Big Ten]] Freshman of the Week.{{cite web|url=http://www.bigten.org/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/031014aac.html|title=Michigan, Nebraska and Indiana Earn Weekly Men's Basketball Honors|work=BigTen.org|date=March 10, 2014|accessdate=July 24, 2016|archive-date=March 10, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140310184547/http://www.bigten.org/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/031014aac.html|url-status=dead}} As a sophomore in 2014–15, Williams played in 32 games, making 28 starts. He was named Big Ten Player of the Week on December 22, [[Oscar Robertson]] National Player of the Week on December 23,{{cite web|url=http://www.sportswriters.net/usbwa/news/2015/oscar141223.html|title=INDIANA'S WILLIAMS IS OSCAR ROBERTSON NATIONAL PLAYER OF THE WEEK|work=SportsWriters.net|date=December 23, 2014|accessdate=July 24, 2016}} and honorable mention [[List of All-Big Ten Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big Ten]] at the season's end. He averaged 7.4 rebounds per game to lead the team, while his 13.0 points per game ranked third on the team. He recorded 11 points, 12 rebounds and four assists in the second round of the [[2015 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|NCAA Tournament]] against [[2014–15 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team|Wichita State]], marking his sixth double-double of the season. Following his sophomore season, Williams considered entering the [[2015 NBA draft]], but decided to return to the Hoosiers for his junior year.{{cite web|first=Zach|last=Osterman|url=http://www.indystar.com/story/hoosier-insider/2015/04/08/troy-williams-plans-to-return-for-junior-season-indiana-hoosiers/25487297/|title=Troy Williams will return to IU for junior season|work=IndyStar.com|date=April 8, 2015|accessdate=July 1, 2015}} As a junior in 2015–16, Williams earned third-team All-Big Ten honors. He played in 35 games and made 34 starts, averaging 13.3 points and 5.8 rebounds per game. On May 25, 2016, Williams declared for the [[NBA draft]], forgoing his final year of college eligibility.{{cite web|first=Michael|last=Hughes|url=http://www.idsnews.com/article/2016/05/troy-williams-officially-declares-for-nba-draft|title=Troy Williams officially declares for NBA draft|work=IDSNews.com|date=May 25, 2016|accessdate=July 24, 2016}} ===College statistics=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2013–14 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2013–14]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2013–14 Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball team|Indiana]] | 32 || 32 || 21.5 || .509 || .207 || .675 || 4.4 || .9 || .8 || .4 || 7.3 |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2014–15]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2014–15 Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball team|Indiana]] | 32 || 28 || '''27.6''' || '''.540''' || '''.462''' || '''.742''' || '''7.4''' || '''2.0''' || 1.0 || .5 || 13.0 |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2015–16 Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball team|Indiana]] | '''35''' || '''34''' || 26.2 || .513 || .347 || .691 || 5.8 || '''2.0''' || '''1.1''' || '''.8''' || '''13.3''' |- | style="text-align:center;" colspan="2"| Career | 99 || 94 || 25.1 || .522 || .325 || .705 || 5.9 || 1.6 || 1.0 || .6 || 11.3 {{S-end}} ==Professional career== ===Memphis Grizzlies (2016–2017)=== After going undrafted in the [[2016 NBA draft]], Williams joined the [[Phoenix Suns]] for the [[2016 NBA Summer League]].{{cite web|first=Alex|last=Bozich|url=http://www.insidethehall.com/2016/06/24/troy-williams-signs-summer-league-deal-phoenix/|title=Troy Williams signs summer league deal with Phoenix|work=InsideTheHall.com|date=June 24, 2016|accessdate=July 24, 2016}} In six games at Las Vegas, he averaged 12.3 points, 4.3 rebounds and 1.7 steals in 22.2 minutes per game. On August 8, 2016, he signed with the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/selden-stephens-williams-wroten-signed-160808|title=Grizzlies sign Wayne Selden Jr., D.J. Stephens, Troy Williams and Tony Wroten|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc.|date=August 8, 2016|accessdate=August 8, 2016}} Williams secured an opening-night roster spot after impressing the Grizzlies during training camp and preseason.{{cite web|first=Michael|last=Wallace|url=http://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grind-city-media/wallace-view-troy-williams-161022|title=Grizz rookie Williams securing opening-night roster spot|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc.|date=October 22, 2016|accessdate=October 22, 2016}} He made his debut for the Grizzlies in their second game of the season on October 29, 2016, recording three points, one assist and two steals in nine minutes off the bench in a 111–104 loss to the [[New York Knicks]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/boxscore?gameId=400899478|title=Grizzlies vs. Knicks – Box Score|work=ESPN.com|date=October 29, 2016|access-date=October 30, 2016}} On November 26, 2016, he had an 18-point effort in a 110–107 win over the [[Miami Heat]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=400899693|title=Conley's late flurry lifts Grizzlies over Heat, 110-107|work=ESPN.com|date=November 26, 2016|access-date=November 27, 2016}} On January 30, 2017, he was waived by the Grizzlies.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/toney-douglas-re-signed-170130|title=Grizzlies re-sign Toney Douglas to 10-day contract|work=NBA.com|date=January 30, 2017|accessdate=January 30, 2017}} During his time with Memphis, Williams received multiple assignments to the [[Iowa Wolves|Iowa Energy]] of [[NBA Development League]].{{cite web|url=http://dleague.nba.com/assignments/|title=2016-17 2017|accessdate=February 19, 2017}} ===Houston Rockets (2017–2018)=== On March 10, 2017, Williams signed a 10-day contract with the [[Houston Rockets]], and was immediately assigned to the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-sign-troy-williams-10-day-contract|title=Rockets Sign Troy Williams to 10-Day Contract|work=NBA.com|date=March 10,
